items.quote: The Dubai real estate market needed a claim. And this is exactly what is happening now.

items.quote: they're losing the jobs, the agents already flying to Thailand or Bali because they cannot make money in Dubai real estate anymore.

items.quote: We all wanted less competition, we all wanted less project, less development.
items.statement: The desire for less competition and fewer projects is prevalent.

items.quote: the leads you will be getting now are those who are really, despite all of the noise, understand the value of Dubai real estate beyond the market price.
items.statement: The quality of leads is changing to those who value Dubai real estate beyond price.

items.quote: to sell and shift the mindset, not convince, shift the mindset of your clients.
items.statement: Salespeople need to shift the mindset of their clients instead of just convincing them.

items.quote: I do have a strategy session where, oh I call it a source session, where I teach you how step by step succeed in this frozen and slowly going down market.
items.statement: I offer a strategy session to help succeed in a declining market.

overview: A source chunk discussing the Dubai real estate market and selling strategies in a difficult environment.
